_README: Exit criterion: no URL that worked before launch may break after it.
The case that must not break is a past Circle member reaching her
archive — she paid for it, and her bookmark is the only way back.
Fill `rules` from a real inventory of every Podia URL in circulation:
Instagram bio, past emails, gift cards already issued, member bookmarks,
and anything Podia itself links. docs/launch.md has a paste-ready prompt
from   path on the apex, as it exists TODAY
to     where it should land AFTER the cutover
note   why this rule exists — future-you will want it
`npm run preflight` checks every rule parses, and that internal targets
actually exist in the build. An empty map blocks --launch on purpose.
